subject: Provisional discount request for RBX Analytics launch delay
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, 'RBX Legal' <legal@rbxanalytics.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Apr 2029 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Provisional discount request for RBX Analytics launch delay

Hi team,

Quick context: RBX Analytics (Sarah) signed a three-year commitment last week — committed ARR $420k. Their integration depends on a bulk-embedding export feature we committed to deliver in our Q2 roadmap; RBX just informed us the feature is slipping by ~7 weeks due to an internal data mapping issue on their side, which means their go-live will be delayed and they are asking for a short-term commercial accommodation to keep momentum.

They've asked for either a temporary discount for the first 3 months post-launch or a one-time implementation credit tied to usage. Suggested ask from the customer: 25% off hosted usage for 3 months (estimated impact ~$38k). Their legal/ops want this documented as a provisional accommodation with clear conditions.

Why we should consider it: high referenceability (strategic name for our analytics vertical), potential expansion opportunity if early success, and they committed to a staged rollout that will likely increase spend after feature availability.

What I need from you:
- Product (Karthik): confirm we cannot reasonably accelerate the feature or offer a functional temporary substitute (e.g., cadence-based exports) that would avoid a commercial concession.
- Finance (Laura): advise acceptable cap / duration / accounting treatment for a provisional discount.
- Legal: confirm minimal amendment language (I attached a draft MAP and SOW redlines).
- Sales leadership (Jonas / Rafael): please endorse a narrowed play (amount + cap) so I can close while preserving margin.

Attachments: RBX_Mutual_Action_Plan.pdf, SOW_redlines.docx
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/RBX-2029-Q2-019

Customer note (Sarah): "We want to ensure our execs see a commercial gesture while we stabilize the integration — we expect to accelerate in month 4."

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, RBX Legal <legal@rbxanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Apr 2029 11:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Provisional discount request for RBX Analytics launch delay

Marissa — thanks for the context. A couple of product points: the bulk-embedding export feature is scoped and staffed but we can provide a staged workaround (scheduled batched exports) that would mitigate their immediate need for live bulk export in many cases. That workaround has an operational overhead (manual steps + monitoring) and isn't ideal, but it may be sufficient for the first 6–8 weeks.

I'm open to a commercial accommodation if the workaround is unacceptable to RBX, but I'd prefer we consider a timeboxed credit with a cap rather than an open percentage off usage. Proposal from product POV: offer a 90-day transitional credit tied to verified incremental usage loss (we can define an attribution metric), or we enable the scheduled batched export with priority support while product ships the permanent feature.

Can sales confirm if RBX will accept the workaround? If not, please open with a capped credit number so finance can advise.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Product Management — Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, RBX Legal <legal@rbxanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Apr 2029 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Provisional discount request for RBX Analytics launch delay

Thanks — reviewed the numbers. Given deal size and strategic value, Finance is comfortable with a provisional accommodation under the following guardrails:

1) Term: 90 days post-launch
2) Rate: up to 30% off hosted usage, but with a hard cap of $50,000 total credit for the account (applied as invoice credit).
3) Conditions: customer must accept the staged workaround or sign a short amendment acknowledging the temporary nature and committing to the roll-forward plan in the attached MAP.
4) Accounting: treat as contra-revenue; we'll reserve against Q2.

Legal should prepare a 1-page amendment (short-form) capturing the credit cap, conditions, and evidence required to trigger the credit (simple usage/uptime attest). Rafael / Jonas — if you agree we can route this for executive signoff (VP revenue) today.

Laura Bennett
Head of Finance, Commercial
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: RBX Legal <legal@rbxanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Apr 2029 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Provisional discount request for RBX Analytics launch delay

Jonas — quick escalation summary and ask for signoff:
- Customer: RBX Analytics, committed ARR $420k, strategic reference prospect.
- Ask: 90-day discount, up to 30%, capped at $50k (finance approved guardrails).
- Rationale: preserves momentum, protects expansion path, low probability of long-term margin loss given expected post-launch ramp.

I recommend approval. We will require RBX to sign the short amendment and accept the staged workaround if that accelerates go-live. Docs attached (MAP + SOW redlines). Can you approve so I can communicate a firm outcome to the customer?

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Sales Manager, Enterprise Accounts
rafael_mendes@redwood.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: RBX Legal <legal@rbxanalytics.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Apr 2029 16:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Provisional discount request for RBX Analytics launch delay — APPROVED

Approved.

Authorization: temporary commercial accommodation for RBX Analytics — 90 days post-launch, up to 30% off hosted usage, capped at $50,000 total credit. Conditions: customer signs the short-form amendment, accepts the staged workaround (if agreed), and Redwood will track the credit trigger events (usage evidence).

Operational notes:
- Legal: please draft the 1-page amendment with the exact cap/conditions and route to RBX Legal for signature.
- Finance: Laura, please confirm invoice mechanics and GL treatment, and set the reserve.
- Product: Karthik, please confirm the staged workaround runbook and a support contact (we need an SLO for the interim process).
- Marissa / Rafael: inform the customer and request acceptance in writing; attach signed amendment to HubSpot deal file.

I'll follow up if any deviation is needed. Good to close the loop quickly so RBX doesn't pause implementation.

Jonas Weber
VP, Revenue Operations
jonas_weber@redwood.com
